summary: The blemishes that make an animal unfit for a korban also stop a Kohen from doing the avodah. A Kohen has some extra blemishes too, like an oddly shaped head.

chunks.en: These blemishes,
chunks.st: Concerning these blemishes which were taught with regard to an animal,

chunks.en: whether they last or pass,
chunks.st: whether they are permanent or transient,

chunks.en: make a person unfit too.
chunks.st: they also disqualify in the case of a person,
chunks.stMore: i.e., they disqualify a priest from performing the Temple service.

chunks.en: More than these, for a person:
chunks.st: And in addition to those
chunks.stMore: blemishes, there are other blemishes that apply only to a priest:

chunks.en: one whose head is pointed, or shaped like a turnip,
chunks.st: One whose head is pointed, narrow above and wide below; and one whose head is turnip-like, wide above and narrow below;

chunks.en: one whose head is like a hammer, or has a dent, or sticks out in back.
chunks.st: and one whose head is hammer-like, with his forehead protruding; and one whose head has an indentation; and one wherein the back of his head protrudes.

chunks.en: A Kohen with a hunched back:
chunks.st: And with regard to those with humped backs,

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehudah says he is fit,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda deems them fit for service

chunks.en: and the Sages say he is unfit.
chunks.st: and the Rabbis deem them disqualified.

summary: More blemishes of a Kohen: hair around the head, eyebrows, and the back.

chunks.en: A bald Kohen is unfit.
chunks.st: The kere’aḥ is disqualified from performing the Temple service.

chunks.en: Who is called bald?
chunks.st: What is a kere’aḥ?

chunks.he: כֹּל שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שִׁטָּה שֶׁל שֵׂעָר
chunks.en: Anyone who does not have a line of hair
chunks.st: It is anyone who does not have a row of hair

chunks.en: going around from ear to ear.
chunks.st: encircling his head from ear to ear.

chunks.en: If he has it,
chunks.st: If he has a row of hair from ear to ear,

chunks.en: he is fit.
chunks.st: that person is fit for service.

chunks.en: If he has no eyebrows,
chunks.st: If a priest has no eyebrows,

chunks.en: or he has only one eyebrow,
chunks.st: or if he has only one eyebrow,

chunks.en: he is the "gibben" that the Torah talks about.
chunks.st: that is the gibben that is stated in the Torah
chunks.stMore: in the list of blemished priests (see Leviticus 21:20).

chunks.en: Rabbi Dosa says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Dosa says:

chunks.en: anyone whose eyebrows lie flat over his eyes.
chunks.st: A gibben is one whose eyebrows are so long that they lie flat and cover his eyes.

chunks.en: Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus says:

chunks.he: כֹּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שְׁנֵי גַבִּים וּשְׁתֵּי שִׁדְרָאוֹת:
chunks.en: anyone who has two backs and two backbones.
chunks.st: A gibben is one who has two backs and two spines.

summary: Blemishes of a Kohen's eyes and nose.

chunks.en: A charum is unfit.
chunks.st: The ḥarum is disqualified from performing the Temple service.

chunks.en: Who is a charum?
chunks.st: What is a ḥarum?

chunks.en: One who can paint both his eyes at once, with one stroke.
chunks.st: It is one who can paint both of his eyes as one,
chunks.stMore: with one brushstroke, because he has a sunken nose.

chunks.en: Both his eyes are high up,
chunks.st: If both of one’s eyes are above

chunks.en: or both his eyes are low,
chunks.st: or both of his eyes are below;

chunks.en: one eye is high
chunks.st: or if one of his eyes is above

chunks.en: and one eye is low,
chunks.st: and one of his eyes is below;

chunks.he: רוֹאֶה אֶת הַחֶדֶר וְאֶת הָעֲלִיָּה כְּאֶחָת,
chunks.en: he sees the room downstairs and the upstairs at the same time,
chunks.st: or if both eyes are in the proper place but he sees both the room on the ground floor and the upper story as one, at the same time;

chunks.en: one who cannot look at the sun,
chunks.st: and likewise those unable to look at the sun;

chunks.en: one whose eyes are different, and one whose eyes always tear,
chunks.st: and one whose eyes are different; and one whose eyes tear constantly,
chunks.stMore: these are disqualified from performing the Temple service.

words.note: One eye a different color from the other.
One whose eyes always run with tears.

chunks.en: And one whose eyelashes fell out
chunks.st: And one whose eyelashes have fallen out

chunks.en: is unfit because of how it looks.
chunks.st: is disqualified from performing the Temple service due to the appearance
chunks.stMore: of a blemish. Unlike the others listed in this mishna, who are disqualified by Torah law, one with this condition is not disqualified by Torah law. Rather, the Sages issued a decree prohibiting a priest with such a condition to perform the Temple service.

summary: More blemishes of a Kohen: eyes, body, nose and ears that are too big or too small.
stIntro: The mishna lists additional blemishes that disqualify a priest from performing the Temple service: If a priest’s

chunks.en: His eyes are big like a calf's,
chunks.st: eyes are large like those of a calf

chunks.en: or small like a goose's,
chunks.st: or small like those of a goose; if

chunks.he: גּוּפוֹ גָּדוֹל מֵאֵבָרָיו אוֹ קָטָן מֵאֵבָרָיו,
chunks.en: his body is too big or too small for his limbs,
chunks.st: his body is disproportionately large relative to his limbs or disproportionately small relative to his limbs; if

chunks.he: חָטְמוֹ גָּדוֹל מֵאֵבָרָיו אוֹ קָטָן מֵאֵבָרָיו,
chunks.en: his nose is too big or too small for his limbs,
chunks.st: his nose is disproportionately large relative to his limbs or disproportionately small relative to his limbs, he is disqualified. And

chunks.en: the tzimem and the tzimei'a.
chunks.st: the tzomem and the tzome’a are also disqualified.

chunks.en: Who is a tzimei'a?
chunks.st: What is a tzome’a?

chunks.en: One whose ears are small.
chunks.st: It is anyone whose ears are small.

chunks.en: And the tzimem is one whose ears look like a sponge.
chunks.st: And what is the tzomem? It is anyone whose ears are similar to a sponge.

summary: More blemishes of a Kohen, of the lips, teeth and body. The Rabbis argue about the meaning of one blemish named in the Torah.

chunks.en: If his upper lip sticks out over the lower one,
chunks.st: If his upper lip protrudes beyond the lower lip

chunks.en: or the lower sticks out over the upper,
chunks.st: or his lower lip protrudes beyond the upper lip,

chunks.en: this is a blemish.
chunks.st: that is a blemish.

chunks.en: One whose teeth were taken out
chunks.st: And one whose teeth fell out

chunks.en: is unfit because of how it looks.
chunks.st: is disqualified due to the appearance
chunks.stMore: of a blemish. The mishna lists additional blemishes that disqualify a priest from performing the Temple service:

chunks.en: One whose chest sags,
chunks.st: One who has breasts so large that they sag like those of a woman; or if one’s

chunks.en: one whose belly is swollen,
chunks.st: belly is swollen and protrudes; or if one’s

chunks.en: one whose belly button sticks out,
chunks.st: navel protrudes; or if one is

chunks.en: one who has fits, even once in a long while,
chunks.st: an epileptic, even if he experiences seizures only once in a long while;

chunks.en: one who gets a sad, gloomy mood,
chunks.st: or one who is afflicted with a melancholy temper;

chunks.en: and one with a body part that is too big.
chunks.st: or one whose scrotum is unnaturally long; or one whose penis is unnaturally long
chunks.stMore: is disqualified from performing the Temple service.

words.en: the one with a big part

chunks.en: If he is missing a body part,
chunks.st: If one has no testicles,

chunks.he: אוֹ אֵין לוֹ אֶלָּא בֵיצָה אַחַת,
chunks.en: or he has only one,
chunks.st: or if he has only one testicle,

chunks.en: this is the "mero'ach ashech" that the Torah talks about.
chunks.st: that is the mero’aḥ ashekh that is stated in the Torah
chunks.stMore: (see Leviticus 21:20) among the blemishes that disqualify a priest from Temple service.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yishmael says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yishmael says: A mero’aḥ ashekh is

chunks.en: anyone whose body part was crushed.
chunks.st: anyone whose testicles were crushed.

chunks.en: Rabbi Akiva says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Akiva says:

chunks.en: anyone whose body part is swollen.
chunks.st: It is anyone that has wind in his testicles, i.e., they are swollen.

chunks.en: Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus says:
chunks.stMore: Mero’aḥ ashekh does not refer to the testicles; rather, the reference is to

chunks.en: anyone whose looks are dark.
chunks.st: anyone whose appearance [marav] is especially dark [ḥashukhin].

summary: More blemishes of a Kohen's legs, feet and fingers. Some problems make a Kohen unfit but not an animal.
stIntro: The mishna lists additional blemishes that disqualify a priest from performing the Temple service: One whose legs are crooked and bend inward, causing him to

chunks.en: One whose ankles or knees knock together,
chunks.st: knock his ankles or his knees into each other as he walks,

chunks.en: one with a bump, and one with bowed legs.
chunks.st: and a ba’al happikim, and the ikkel.

chunks.en: Who is bow-legged?
chunks.st: What is the ikkel?

chunks.en: Anyone who puts his feet together
chunks.st: It is anyone who places his feet together

chunks.en: and his knees do not touch each other.
chunks.st: and his knees do not knock into each other, i.e., he is bowlegged.

chunks.en: A bump that sticks out from his big toe,
chunks.st: A priest with a protuberance emerging alongside the thumb of his hand or the big toe of his foot,

chunks.en: his heel sticks out to the back,
chunks.st: or one whose heel emerges and protrudes back from his foot,

chunks.en: his foot is wide like a goose's.
chunks.st: or one whose feet are wide like those of a goose
chunks.stMore: are all disqualified from performing the Temple service.

chunks.en: His fingers lie on top of each other,
chunks.st: A priest whose fingers or toes are configured one upon the other,

chunks.en: or are stuck together.
chunks.st: or one whose fingers or toes are attached, is likewise disqualified.

chunks.en: If only up to the joint, he is fit.
chunks.st: But if they were attached from above the palm of the hand or the bottom of the foot only until the middle joint, he is fit.

chunks.en: If they were stuck below the joint and he cut them apart, he is fit.
chunks.st: If they were attached below the joint, higher up on the finger or toe, and he cut to separate them, he is fit.

chunks.en: If he had an extra finger and cut it off:
chunks.st: In a case where there was an extra finger or toe on his hand or foot and he cut it,

chunks.en: if it has a bone, he is unfit,
chunks.st: if that extra appendage contains a bone, the priest is disqualified even after it was cut,

chunks.en: and if not, he is fit.
chunks.st: and if there is no bone the priest is fit.

chunks.he: יָתֵר בְּיָדָיו וּבְרַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע,
chunks.en: If he has extra fingers and toes on his hands and feet, six and six, twenty-four in all,
chunks.st: If there was an extra appendage on his hands and on his feet, six on each for a total of twenty-four,

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehudah says he is fit,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda deems the priest fit

chunks.en: and the Sages say he is unfit.
chunks.st: and the Rabbis deem him disqualified.

chunks.en: One who uses both hands equally:
chunks.st: With regard to one who is ambidextrous and has control of both of his hands,

chunks.en: Rebbi says he is unfit,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi deems the priest disqualified,
chunks.stMore: as his halakhic status is like that of one who is left-handed,

chunks.en: and the Sages say he is fit.
chunks.st: and the Rabbis deem him fit.

chunks.en: One with very dark skin, one with very red skin,
chunks.st: Concerning the kushi, the giḥor,

chunks.en: one with very white skin, one who is very tall,
chunks.st: the lavkan, the kipe’aḥ,

chunks.en: a very short person, one who cannot hear or speak,
chunks.st: the dwarf, the deaf-mute,

chunks.en: one who is not mentally fit, one who is drunk,
chunks.st: the imbecile, the drunk,

chunks.en: and one with tahor tzara'as marks:
chunks.st: and those with ritually pure marks,

chunks.en: these make a person unfit,
chunks.st: their conditions disqualify a person from performing the Temple service

chunks.en: but are fine in an animal.
chunks.st: and are valid, i.e., they do not disqualify with regard to being sacrificed, in the case of an animal.

chunks.en: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says,
chunks.st: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:

chunks.en: an animal that is not fit in its mind is not the best.
chunks.st: An imbecile among animals is not optimal for sacrifice.

chunks.en: Rabbi Eliezer says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Elazar says:

chunks.en: also those with hanging skin or flesh
chunks.st: Even with regard to those with flesh or skin that hangs from their body,

chunks.en: are unfit in a person,
chunks.st: that blemish disqualifies in the case of a person

chunks.en: and fit in an animal.
chunks.st: and is valid in the case of an animal.

summary: Some things make an animal unfit for a korban but not a Kohen. A Kohen who did certain sins may not do the avodah until he promises to stop.

chunks.en: These are fit in a person
chunks.st: These flaws do not disqualify a person from performing the Temple service,

chunks.en: but unfit in an animal:
chunks.st: but they do disqualify an animal
chunks.stMore: from being sacrificed: An animal whose mother or offspring were slaughtered that day, as slaughtering it would violate the prohibition against slaughtering the animal

chunks.en: an animal and its child shechted on the same day,
chunks.st: itself and its offspring on the same day;

chunks.en: a treifah, and one born through its mother's side,
chunks.st: a tereifa; one born by caesarean section;

chunks.en: one that was used for a sin, and one that killed a person.
chunks.st: one with which a transgression of bestiality was performed; and one that killed a person.

chunks.en: A Kohen who marries women he may not marry
chunks.st: And a priest who marries women by a transgression,
chunks.stMore: e.g., a divorcée or a woman who underwent ḥalitza,

chunks.en: is unfit until he makes a neder not to get any benefit from her.
chunks.st: is disqualified from performing the Temple service until he vows not to derive benefit from her.
chunks.stMore: The vow ensures that he will divorce her promptly.

chunks.en: A Kohen who makes himself tamei to the dead
chunks.st: And a priest who becomes impure through exposure to corpses

chunks.en: is unfit until he takes upon himself that he will not
chunks.st: is disqualified from performing the Temple service until he accepts upon himself a commitment

chunks.en: become tamei to the dead again.
chunks.st: that he will no longer become impure through exposure to corpses.
